strings.subtitle: — Fael sie —
strings.dnd_hint: (anaa twe fael bi bɛ gu mfɛnsɛ yi mu)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Twe ne gu nni hɔ. Fa bɔtɔ a ɛwɔ ase no di dwuma.
strings.ssd_warning:
Kɔkɔbɔ! Wɔ SSD so, ɛkyerɛw kwan no nnye nni sɛ ɛbɛsɛe ɛsiane TRIM nti.
Saa dwumadi yi yɛ HDD dea.
strings.confirm_text:
Wɔbɛkyerɛw fael "{name}" so na wɔapɛpepa no.

Toa so?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  WƆAKYERƐW FAEL NO SO NA WƆAPƐPEPA NO
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS nsɛm foforɔ (ADS) nnyɛ hwee.
• USN nhoma no nntɔɔ.
• Sunsuma mfonini ne wimu nkitahodie
  (OneDrive ne nea ɛkeka ho) nka.
strings.status_full: Wɔakyerɛw emu nsɛm nyinaa so kwa. Ntumi nnya bi bio — akadeɛ bɛhunu kwa nko ara.
strings.status_fast: Wɔakyerɛw ti, dua ne 4 MB nsensɛn no so. Nea aka no, wɔannya so, nanso ɛsiane ntokuro nti, akadeɛ a wɔde di dwuma ntumi nnya fael no nyinaa bio. De maa nsɛm kokoam, fa mode PÉPÉÉ di dwuma.
strings.status_empty: Fael no yɛ kwa, na ɛnhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw so. Wɔapɛpepa no.
strings.error_permission: Entumi nkɔ fael no so. Ebia ɛbue wɔ dwumadi foforɔ mu. To mu na sane sɔ hwɛ.
strings.error_not_found: Wɔannya fael no. Ebia wɔapɛpepa no deda.
strings.error_is_symlink: Wei yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne kwan. Wontumi nsɛe kwan — fael a wɔkɔ no so no bɛyɛ den.
strings.error_reparse: Wei yɛ beae fael (OneDrive anaa nea ɛte saa). Ne nsɛm wɔ wimu, ɛnyɛ disk so — hwee nni ha a wɔbɛsɛe.
strings.error_not_file: Wei nyɛ fael (folda anaa biribi foforɔ). Gu fael bi.
strings.error_hardlinks: Saa fael yi wɔ nkitahodie den foforɔ ({n} nyinaa). Nkitahodie den nni ɔhwɛfoɔ — din nyinaa yɛ pɛ. Sɛ wosɛe fa kwan a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei so a, nsɛm no bɛkyerɛw so na wɔatwa no 32 byte, nanso nea aka no bɛkɔ so ayɛ kwan wɔ nkitahodie foforɔ so. Popa nkitahodie nyinaa kan.
strings.error_compressed:
Wɔakyekyem fael no, wɔasum no anaasɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw. Kyerɛw so kwa nnye nni sɛ ɛbɛsɛe nsɛm deda no ɛsiane NTFS sie no kwan foforɔ so.

Yi ɛyɛ no fi hɔ: fa nsa nifa kɔ so → Nsɛnkyerɛnne → Akwanhwɛ → yi ahyɛnsodeɛ "Kyekyem" ne/anaa "Sum" fi hɔ. Ɛno akyi, san kɔ SHREDDER.
